ModMetaData.name: CE Reload Magazine Threshold
ModMetaData.author: TSA
ModMetaData.description: Sets a configurable Combat Extended opportunistic reload threshold (default 80% of magazine size) when a colony pawn equips a magazine weapon or a player CE turret initializes, if the threshold is still CE's default (0). Fine-tune per weapon via the ammo gizmo. Includes a mod settings slider (0–100%) and restore defaults.
